serverInfo.name: MoneyMatter Finance Tracker
serverInfo.title: MoneyMatter — Personal Finance MCP Server
serverInfo.description: OAuth-secured read/write access to your MoneyMatter financial data: accounts, transactions (including splits, refunds, transfers, and groups), trackers, savings goals, subscriptions, transaction automations (rules engine), categories, tags, cash flow, balance history, spending analytics, and investment portfolios (holdings, cash balances, and investment transactions). Supports creating, editing, and deleting records when the corresponding scopes are granted. Enables natural-language queries and automation of your personal finances. Tools come in toolsets: core is always on, and each other toolset is granted with its toolset:<id> scope on the consent screen.

toolsets.name: core
toolsets.description: Accounts, transactions, transfers and refunds, attachments, categories, tags, payees and reports. Always on, needs no scope.

toolsets.name: subscriptions
toolsets.description: Recurring payments, their periods and candidates, and planned transactions.

toolsets.name: budget-plans
toolsets.description: Budget plans with their groups, lines and line goals, and savings goals.

toolsets.name: trackers
toolsets.description: Spending trackers, their lines and suggestions.

toolsets.name: automations
toolsets.description: Transaction rules, payee aliases, ignored payee names and tag reminders.

toolsets.name: review
toolsets.description: Refund and transfer matches, duplicate cleanup and stuck pending transactions.

toolsets.name: investments
toolsets.description: Portfolios, holdings, securities, investment transactions and portfolio transfers.

toolsets.name: loans-vehicles
toolsets.description: Loans with their payments and notes, and vehicles.

toolsets.name: imports
toolsets.description: Import batches (list, undo) and bank connections (status, unlink an account); sharing is read only.

tools.name: adjust_account_balance
tools.description: Set an account to a specific balance by creating an adjustment transaction for the difference. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: archive_account
tools.description: Archive or unarchive a user account. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: assign_tags_to_transaction
tools.description: Assign one or more tags to a transaction. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: bulk_delete_payees
tools.description: Permanently delete many payees at once. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: bulk_delete_transactions
tools.description: Move many transactions to Trash at once, by ids or by filters. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: bulk_update_transactions
tools.description: Update multiple transactions at once. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a manual account. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_attachment_upload_url
tools.description: Get a short-lived upload URL for attaching receipt/invoice files (JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF) to a transaction. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_category
tools.description: Create a new transaction category. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_payee
tools.description: Create a Payee (merchant/counterparty) for the user. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag that can be assigned to transactions. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Create a new transaction (income, expense, or transfer). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Permanently delete an account together with all its transactions. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Permanently delete a file attached to a transaction. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_category
tools.description: Permanently delete a category by ID. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_payee
tools.description: Delete a Payee. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_split
tools.description: Delete a single split from a transaction by its split ID (UUID string). Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag by ID. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_transaction
tools.description: Move a transaction to Trash by ID. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read one account: balances (original and base currency), opening balance, credit limit, category, status, bank link and logo, plus transactionCount, the number of transactions the account holds (null for an account shared with the user).

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: List all user accounts with current balances.

tools.name: get_balance_history
tools.description: Get account balance over time.

tools.name: get_cash_flow
tools.description: Get income, expenses, and net cash flow for a period with configurable granularity (monthly/biweekly/weekly).

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all transaction categories.

tools.name: get_category_transaction_count
tools.description: Count the transactions filed under a category, planned ones and split lines included.

tools.name: get_cumulative_stats
tools.description: Get running totals of expenses, income or savings by month for a period, next to the period of the same length right before it, plus the percent change, in the base currency.

tools.name: get_earliest_transaction_date
tools.description: Get the date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the first transaction on record, or null when there are none.

tools.name: get_expenses_for_period
tools.description: Get total expense amount for a date range.

tools.name: get_net_worth_drivers
tools.description: Explain what moved net worth, period by period, in the base currency: savings (income, expenses, net), investment growth (price effect, dividends, fees and taxes, per portfolio) and the holdings and cash values at the end of the period.

tools.name: get_net_worth_history
tools.description: Get net worth over time as points, each with assets by kind (cash, investments, vehicles, ventures), liabilities by kind (credit-card, loan, overdraft) and the net worth, in the base currency.

tools.name: get_payee
tools.description: Fetch a single Payee with aliases and computed stats.

tools.name: get_payees
tools.description: List Payees (merchants/counterparties) for the user, optionally filtered by a substring query.

tools.name: get_pivot_report
tools.description: Cross-tab spending or income: rows by category, subcategory, payee or tag against time columns (yearly, quarterly, monthly, weekly), with row and column totals, in the base currency.

tools.name: get_refund_links
tools.description: List every refund link touching a transaction, on either side (as the refund or as the original).

tools.name: get_refunds
tools.description: Read refund links, the pairs of an original transaction and the transaction that refunds it.

tools.name: get_spending_by_categories
tools.description: Get spending breakdown by category for a date range.

tools.name: get_tags
tools.description: List all user tags.

tools.name: get_total_balance
tools.description: Get the user's total balance across all accounts on one date, as { amount, currencyCode, date }, where amount is a number in the base currency and currencyCode is that currency.

tools.name: get_transaction_links
tools.description: Read what a transaction is linked to: the portfolio transfer it funds or pays out (portfolioLink: portfolio, deposit or withdrawal, amount) and the venture event it belongs to (ventureLink: deal).

tools.name: get_transactions_by_id
tools.description: Read transactions by id (up to 50) or both legs of a transfer by transferId.

tools.name: get_transactions_summary
tools.description: Count and totals of the transactions that match the filters, in the base currency: income, expense, net and transfers.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get the user's base currency, configured currencies with exchange rates, and basic profile info.

tools.name: link_refund
tools.description: Mark an existing transaction as a refund of another transaction. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: link_transfer
tools.description: Link two existing transactions as a transfer pair. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: list_transaction_attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to a transaction (receipts, invoices): id, filename, mimeType, size in bytes and upload time.

tools.name: merge_payees
tools.description: Merge a source Payee into a target Payee. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: remove_tags_from_transaction
tools.description: Remove a tag from one or more transactions. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Search and filter transactions.

tools.name: split_transaction
tools.description: Split a transaction across multiple categories. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_refund
tools.description: Remove one refund link, identified by refundTxId + originalTxId; both transactions stay. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_transfer
tools.description: Unlink transfer transactions by their shared transferId (UUID string). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update an account: name, accountCategory, defaultPaymentType (null clears it), creditLimit, excludeFromStats, logo, and balances. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_category
tools.description: Update an existing category by ID. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_payee
tools.description: Update a Payee. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.description: Update an existing tag by ID. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_transaction
tools.description: Update an existing transaction by ID. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: accept_subscription_candidate
tools.description: Accept a pending subscription candidate. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: confirm_planned_transaction
tools.description: Confirm a planned (upcoming) transaction once the money has moved: it becomes a real transaction and counts toward the account balance. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_subscription
tools.description: Create a new subscription, recurring bill, or installment plan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_subscription
tools.description: Permanently delete a subscription or recurring bill. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: detect_subscription_candidates
tools.description: Scan the past 12 months of transactions to detect recurring payment patterns and generate subscription candidates. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: dismiss_subscription_candidate
tools.description: Dismiss a pending subscription candidate so it no longer appears in the candidate list. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_planned_summary
tools.description: Totals of the planned (upcoming, not yet confirmed) transactions per account and currency: plannedDelta in the account currency, refPlannedDelta in the base currency, the number of plans and the latest plan date.

tools.name: get_subscription_by_id
tools.description: Retrieve a single subscription by its ID including all linked transactions (with match source and date) and the computed next expected payment date.

tools.name: get_subscription_periods
tools.description: List a subscription’s billing periods, newest due date first, with the status of each (upcoming, overdue, paid, skipped) and the transaction behind a paid one.

tools.name: get_subscriptions_summary
tools.description: Aggregate summary across all active subscriptions with an expected amount, split by direction.

tools.name: get_subscriptions
tools.description: List all subscriptions and recurring bills for the user.

tools.name: get_upcoming_subscription_payments
tools.description: List upcoming subscription payments sorted by next expected payment date (soonest first).

tools.name: link_transactions_to_subscription
tools.description: Link one or more transactions to a subscription to mark them as payment instances. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: list_subscription_candidates
tools.description: List auto-detected subscription candidates sorted by confidence score.

tools.name: list_subscription_match_suggestions
tools.description: List past transactions (the last 12 months, at most 100, newest first) that a subscription’s matching rules would match but that are not linked to it yet.

tools.name: pay_subscription_period
tools.description: Mark a subscription period as paid and open the next one. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: preview_subscription_payment
tools.description: Preview what paying a subscription period would book: the amount in the account’s currency (converted at today’s rate when the subscription is billed in another currency), and, with periodId, the transactions already linked to the subscription that fall inside the period and could be linked instead of creating a new one.

tools.name: revert_subscription_period
tools.description: Undo a paid or skipped period: it becomes upcoming (or overdue when its due date has passed) again, and the open period the app generated after it is removed unless a later period was already paid or skipped. Requires finance:write scope, and finance:delete scope when it deletes the transaction the app created.

tools.name: skip_subscription_period
tools.description: Skip a subscription period, for a billing cycle that is not paid, and open the next one. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: toggle_subscription_active
tools.description: Activate or deactivate a subscription. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_subscription_period_transaction
tools.description: Detach the transaction a period points at: the transaction is kept (even one the app created for the period) and the period keeps its paid status, but it no longer points at any payment, so a later revert deletes nothing. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_transactions_from_subscription
tools.description: Unlink transactions from a subscription without deleting them. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: Update fields on an existing subscription or bill. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: add_suggested_budget_plan_lines
tools.description: Draft starter lines (and groups) for a budget plan from the spending history of its accounts, skipping categories another line already covers. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: archive_budget_plan_line
tools.description: Archive a line of a budget plan (archived: true) or bring an archived one back (archived: false). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_budget_plan_group
tools.description: Add a group to a budget plan: a named section that lines sit in, shown after the existing groups. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_budget_plan_line
tools.description: Add a line (an envelope for one or more categories) to a budget plan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_budget_plan
tools.description: Create a budget plan (the "Budget" in the app: period envelopes where money is assigned to lines, not the trackers behind create_tracker). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a savings goal: a target amount (optionally by a date) funded by percent shares or fixed amounts of one or more accounts. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_budget_plan_group
tools.description: Delete a group of a budget plan. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_budget_plan_line_goal
tools.description: Delete the goal of a budget plan line. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_budget_plan_line
tools.description: Permanently delete a line of a budget plan with all its category memberships and assignments in every period, so its categories become unbudgeted. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_budget_plan
tools.description: Delete a budget plan. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_goal
tools.description: Permanently delete a savings goal and free its account shares. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_budget_plan_period
tools.description: Read one period of a budget plan: the figures behind the Budget screen.

tools.name: get_budget_plan_scheduled
tools.description: List what is still scheduled in a period of a budget plan, from today on: subscription payments and planned transactions dated in the period.

tools.name: get_budget_plan_suggestion_context
tools.description: Read what a new budget plan could start from, before creating one: the top spending categories of the given accounts over the last three full months.

tools.name: get_budget_plan_trends
tools.description: Compare the last periods of a budget plan: for each, in order from oldest to newest, what was assigned, the activity (spending is negative), the amount carried in and what was available, in total and per line.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.description: List savings goals (active, paused, archived) in the user's order.

tools.name: list_budget_plan_periods
tools.description: List the periods of a budget plan, newest first.

tools.name: list_budget_plans
tools.description: List the budget plans (the "Budget" in the app: period envelopes where money is assigned to lines, not the trackers behind get_trackers), or read one with planId.

tools.name: restore_budget_plan
tools.description: Bring a budget plan back from the trash. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: set_budget_plan_accounts
tools.description: Replace the set of accounts a budget plan counts activity from. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: set_budget_plan_assignment
tools.description: Assign money to a budget plan line in a period, or change its carry policy there. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: set_budget_plan_line_goal
tools.description: Set the goal of a budget plan line: how much it should hold or receive and when. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: snooze_budget_plan_line_goal
tools.description: Snooze the goal of a budget plan line for one period, so it asks for nothing from that period. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_budget_plan_group
tools.description: Rename a group of a budget plan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_budget_plan_line
tools.description: Change a line of a budget plan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_budget_plan
tools.description: Change the settings of a budget plan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update a savings goal. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: accept_tracker_suggestions
tools.description: Accept pending smart-tracking suggestions of a tracker the user owns: each suggested transaction is linked to the tracker. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: add_transactions_to_tracker
tools.description: Manually link one or more transactions to a tracker, alongside any links its category and tag rules add. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: archive_tracker
tools.description: Archive or unarchive a tracker. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_tracker_line
tools.description: Add a line to a tracker: a named category set with its own optional limit. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_tracker
tools.description: Create a tracker with an optional spending limit, date range and logo. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_tracker_line
tools.description: Permanently delete a line from a tracker. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_tracker
tools.description: Permanently delete a tracker and all its transaction links. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_tracker_spending_stats
tools.description: Get spending statistics for a tracker: spending broken down by category and a time-series of expense vs income over the tracker period.

tools.name: get_tracker
tools.description: Get one tracker with its progress: the tracker itself (name, status, type, date range, limit, linked categories, and the share details when it is shared with the user) and its stats (income, expense and balance over the tracker period, how much of the limit is used, how many transactions it covers, and the first and last transaction date).

tools.name: get_trackers
tools.description: List trackers: spending watchers over a date range with an optional limit, holding hand-picked transactions plus those their category and tag rules link.

tools.name: list_tracker_suggestions
tools.description: Smart-tracking state of a tracker the user owns.

tools.name: reject_tracker_suggestions
tools.description: Reject smart-tracking suggestions of a tracker the user owns: pending ones are dismissed, and AI-linked or accepted ones are also unlinked from the tracker. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: remove_transactions_from_tracker
tools.description: Unlink one or more transactions from a tracker. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_tracker_line
tools.description: Update a tracker line: name, categories, limit, or position. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_tracker
tools.description: Update the name, date range, spending limit, or rules (categories, tags, auto-add) of an existing tracker. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: apply_payee_tags_to_transactions
tools.description: Add a payee's default tags (set with update_payee) to every transaction already linked to it, planned ones included. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: apply_transaction_automation
tools.description: Run one saved automation rule on existing transactions, writing the rule's actions to them. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_payee_alias
tools.description: Add an alias to a payee: another name that links future transactions to it. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_tag_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder on a tag. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_transaction_automation
tools.description: Create a transaction automation rule that categorizes, tags, sets a payee, or edits the note of matching transactions. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_payee_alias
tools.description: Delete one alias of a payee. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_tag_reminder
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag reminder. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_transaction_automation
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction automation rule. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_ignored_payee_names
tools.description: List the names on the ignored list, newest first.

tools.name: get_tag_reminders
tools.description: List tag reminders: rules that notify the user about the transactions of a tag, either when the tag total in a period passes an amount (amount_threshold) or when the tag has no transaction in the period (existence_check).

tools.name: get_transaction_automations
tools.description: List the transaction automation rules (rules engine) of the user, ordered by evaluation order.

tools.name: ignore_payee_name
tools.description: Add a name to the ignored list, so it is never turned into a payee automatically when transactions are imported or synced. Requires finance:write scope, and finance:delete scope with force.

tools.name: preview_transaction_automation
tools.description: Dry-run a set of automation conditions against up to the last 1000 eligible existing transactions and return { matchedCount, scannedCount, matches } where matches is capped at 5 sample transactions.

tools.name: reorder_transaction_automations
tools.description: Reorder the transaction automation rules of the user. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unignore_payee_name
tools.description: Remove a name from the ignored list, so imports and syncs may turn it into a payee again. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_tag_reminder
tools.description: Update a tag reminder. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_transaction_automation
tools.description: Update a transaction automation rule. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: dismiss_transfer_suggestion
tools.description: Tell MoneyMatter that a suggested expense/income pair is not a transfer, so list_transfer_suggestions stops offering that pair. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_reconciliation_history
tools.description: List the duplicate cleanups that removed transactions, newest first.

tools.name: get_refund_recommendations
tools.description: Suggest transactions that a refund could be linked to: up to 5 of the opposite type (income for an expense, expense for an income) from the last 6 months, within 50 of the amount in the base currency, leaving out transfers, planned rows and rows that already act as refunds.

tools.name: get_transfer_recommendations
tools.description: Suggest the other leg of a transfer: up to 7 transactions of the opposite type (income for an expense, expense for an income) on other accounts, within 10% of the amount in the base currency and 14 days of the date, leaving out transfers, refunds, planned rows and split parents; same currency and closer amount and date rank first.

tools.name: keep_pending_as_booked
tools.description: Confirm that bank-synced pending transactions are real and booked, so they stop showing as stuck. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: list_stuck_pending_transactions
tools.description: List bank-synced transactions that have been pending for more than 7 days, so the bank probably booked them under a different row.

tools.name: list_transfer_suggestions
tools.description: Scan a period for expenses that look like one leg of a transfer between the caller's accounts.

tools.name: merge_duplicate_transactions
tools.description: Merge duplicate transactions of one account into a survivor: the other rows are removed and their tracker, group and subscription links move to the survivor, which keeps its own data. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: remove_duplicate_transactions
tools.description: Remove duplicate transactions from the books: they disappear from lists, trackers and reports, and the account balance is left as it is. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: restore_removed_transactions
tools.description: Bring back transactions that remove_duplicate_transactions or merge_duplicate_transactions took out of the books. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: add_transactions_to_group
tools.description: Add one or more transactions to an existing transaction group. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_transaction_group
tools.description: Create a new transaction group that bundles related transactions together (e.g. a split bill). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_transaction_template
tools.description: Create a transaction template: a named preset to fill new transactions from. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_transaction_group
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction group. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_transaction_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction template. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_transaction_groups
tools.description: List all transaction groups for the user.

tools.name: get_transaction_templates
tools.description: List the transaction templates: named presets the user fills a new transaction from (type, and optionally an account, a pinned amount, a category, a payee, a payment type, a note, an original currency and tags).

tools.name: remove_transactions_from_group
tools.description: Remove transactions from a group. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_transaction_group
tools.description: Update the name or note of an existing transaction group. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_transaction_template
tools.description: Update a transaction template. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_holding
tools.description: Add a security to a portfolio, so investment transactions can be recorded against it. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_investment_transaction
tools.description: Record a new investment transaction (buy, sell, dividend, fee, etc.) in a portfolio. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_portfolio_cash_transaction
tools.description: Record a direct cash deposit into or withdrawal from an investment portfolio without touching any regular account — no bank transaction is created. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_portfolio
tools.description: Create a new investment portfolio for the user. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_holding
tools.description: Remove a security from a portfolio. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_investment_transaction
tools.description: Permanently delete an investment transaction. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_portfolio_transfer
tools.description: Permanently delete a portfolio transfer, a direct deposit/withdrawal or a currency exchange, and reverse its effect on the portfolio cash balances. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_portfolio
tools.description: Permanently delete a portfolio and, if force is true, all its holdings, transactions, and cash balances. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: exchange_portfolio_currency
tools.description: Record a currency exchange inside a portfolio: sells fromAmount of one cash currency and buys toAmount of another. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: get_investment_contributions
tools.description: Get the money moved into portfolios (net of withdrawals) per period, in the base currency, with the split per portfolio and the net savings of the same period for comparison.

tools.name: get_investment_transactions
tools.description: Investment transaction history: buy, sell, dividend, transfer, tax, fee, cancel, other.

tools.name: get_portfolio_balances
tools.description: Cash balances held in a portfolio, broken down per currency.

tools.name: get_portfolio_holdings
tools.description: Positions held in a portfolio with dynamically calculated market value, cost basis, and realized/unrealized gain (value and percent).

tools.name: get_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Portfolio-level aggregates for a single portfolio: total current market value, total cost basis, realized and unrealized gains (value and percent), cash balances, and total portfolio value (holdings + cash).

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Read one portfolio by id: name, portfolio type (investment/retirement/savings/other), description, enabled state and creation date.

tools.name: get_portfolios_overview
tools.description: Overview of all portfolios in one call.

tools.name: get_portfolios
tools.description: List the user's investment portfolios.

tools.name: get_security_prices
tools.description: Stored closing prices of one security, found by securityId or by symbol with providerName (a security that is stored, even without a holding; not found otherwise), oldest first, each with the date, the close, when it was recorded and its source, as { prices, total }.

tools.name: link_transaction_to_portfolio
tools.description: Link an existing regular transaction to an investment portfolio as a cash transfer. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: list_portfolio_transfers
tools.description: Cash movement history of a portfolio: account↔portfolio transfers, direct deposits/withdrawals, linked bank transactions, and currency exchanges.

tools.name: restore_portfolio
tools.description: Restore a portfolio that was deleted without force, with its holdings, transactions and cash balances. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: search_securities
tools.description: Search for securities (stocks, ETFs, crypto, etc.) by ticker symbol or company name.

tools.name: set_portfolio_transfer_adjustment
tools.description: Flag a portfolio transfer as an adjustment, or clear the flag. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: transfer_account_to_portfolio
tools.description: Move cash from a regular account into an investment portfolio. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: transfer_between_portfolios
tools.description: Move cash from one portfolio to another, in one currency. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: transfer_portfolio_to_account
tools.description: Withdraw cash from an investment portfolio into a regular account. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_transaction_from_portfolio
tools.description: Remove the portfolio link from a transaction: deletes the portfolio transfer, reverses the portfolio cash balance change, and restores the transaction to a regular income/expense. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_investment_transaction
tools.description: Update an existing investment transaction — correct the date, quantity, price, fees, settlement leg, category, or label. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_portfolio
tools.description: Update an existing portfolio's name, type, description, or enabled state. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_venture_deal
tools.description: Create a venture deal (private/illiquid investment record). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_venture_event
tools.description: Record an event on a venture deal. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_venture_platform
tools.description: Create a venture investment platform (e.g. AngelList, a syndicate, a fund manager) so its default fees can be auto-applied when creating new deals. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_venture_deal
tools.description: Delete a venture deal. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_venture_event_link
tools.description: Remove one transaction link from a venture event. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_venture_event
tools.description: Delete a venture event. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_venture_platform
tools.description: Delete a venture platform. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_venture_contributions
tools.description: Get the net amount contributed to each venture deal in a date range, in the base currency.

tools.name: get_venture_deal_metrics
tools.description: Compute aggregated metrics for a venture deal: cost basis, current value (latest NAV), total distributions, absolute and percent P&L, TVPI (total value to paid-in), DPI (distributions to paid-in), and IRR.

tools.name: get_venture_deal
tools.description: Retrieve a single venture deal by id, including its platform and currency.

tools.name: get_venture_event
tools.description: Retrieve a single venture event by id, including its link rows (bank transactions linked to this event).

tools.name: get_venture_platform
tools.description: Retrieve a single venture platform by id.

tools.name: link_transactions_to_venture_event
tools.description: Link existing bank transactions to a venture event as the cash behind it. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: list_venture_deals
tools.description: List the user's venture deals (private/illiquid investments through SPVs, syndicates, or direct vehicles).

tools.name: list_venture_events
tools.description: List events for a venture deal in chronological order (oldest first).

tools.name: list_venture_platforms
tools.description: List the user's venture investment platforms (SPV syndicators, fund managers).

tools.name: replace_venture_event_links
tools.description: Replace the whole set of bank transactions linked to a venture event: every current link is removed (each transaction gets its original state back), then the given transactions are linked under the rules of link_transactions_to_venture_event (same currency, not already linked elsewhere). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_venture_deal
tools.description: Update a venture deal. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_venture_event
tools.description: Update a venture event. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_venture_platform
tools.description: Update an existing venture platform's name, website, description, or default fees. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: add_loan_note
tools.description: Add a note to the timeline of a loan (for example "rate fixed until 2030"). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_loan
tools.description: Create a loan: a liability account with the loan terms. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: create_vehicle
tools.description: Create a vehicle: an asset account whose value follows a depreciation curve from the purchase price and date. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_loan
tools.description: Permanently delete a loan and its account. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_vehicle
tools.description: Permanently delete a vehicle together with its account and the account's history. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_loan_balance_history
tools.description: The outstanding balance of a loan over time, in the loan currency: the opening balance followed by one end-of-day point per day that has payments, oldest first.

tools.name: get_loans
tools.description: List the loans (mortgage, auto, student, personal), or read one with loanId.

tools.name: get_vehicles
tools.description: List the vehicles (cars and other vehicles tracked as an asset), or read one with vehicleId.

tools.name: link_loan_payments
tools.description: Record existing expense transactions as payments on a loan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: unlink_loan_payment
tools.description: Undo a loan payment: the loan-side leg is deleted, the source transaction is restored to a plain expense and the outstanding balance goes back up. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_loan
tools.description: Update a loan. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_vehicle
tools.description: Update a vehicle. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: add_user_currencies
tools.description: Add currencies to the ones the user holds, so accounts and transactions can use them. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_exchange_rates
tools.description: Remove the user's own exchange rates for currency pairs, so the pair falls back to the market rate. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: delete_user_currency
tools.description: Stop holding a currency. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Read an exchange rate for a day.

tools.name: get_user_currencies
tools.description: Get the currencies the user holds: baseCurrency (the reporting currency, null before one is set), currencies (every held currency with its settings: liveRateUpdate and exchangeRate) and exchangeRates (today's rate of each currency to the base).

tools.name: list_supported_currencies
tools.description: List every ISO 4217 currency the app supports, with its code, name and decimals.

tools.name: set_exchange_rates
tools.description: Set the user's own exchange rates for currency pairs. Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: update_user_currency
tools.description: Change how one held currency is valued: exchangeRate (the flat rate to the base currency) and liveRateUpdate (true follows the market rate, false keeps the manual one). Requires finance:write scope.

tools.name: delete_import_batch
tools.description: Undo an import: permanently delete every transaction the batch created, reverse the balance shift the import absorbed, and remove accounts the import created once they are empty. Requires finance:delete scope.

tools.name: get_bank_sync_status
tools.description: Read the sync state of the bank-connected accounts: the last automatic sync, a summary (total, syncing, queued, completed, failed, idle), per account its status, startedAt, completedAt and error, the connections that need reconnecting (connectionsNeedingReauth) and the consent state of every connection (connectionStatuses).

tools.name: get_import_batch_delete_status
tools.description: Read the state of the latest background import batch delete of the signed-in user, the job delete_import_batch starts for a batch above 1000 rows.

tools.name: list_bank_connections
tools.description: List the bank connections of the signed-in user (a bank or data provider linked to MoneyMatter), or read one with connectionId.

tools.name: list_import_batches
tools.description: List the import batches of the signed-in user, newest first: every CSV, YNAB, statement, Wallet, MS Money and OFX import that still has transactions to undo.

tools.name: list_share_invitations
tools.description: List the sharing invitations of the signed-in user: the ones they sent (every status: pending, accepted, declined, revoked, expired) and the pending ones addressed to them.

tools.name: list_share_members
tools.description: List who has access to an account, household or tracker the signed-in user manages: the owner and every member who accepted.

tools.name: list_shared_with_me
tools.description: List the accounts, households and trackers other people shared with the signed-in user.

tools.name: unlink_account_from_bank_connection
tools.description: Disconnect a bank-connected account from its bank. Requires finance:write scope.

prompts.name: financial_data_guide
prompts.description: Guidelines for understanding MoneyMatter financial data conventions. Read this before analyzing user data.
